knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Leasing and deposit handling are not accepted until the positions are confirmed. The request is recorded and referred.
The leasing licence position differs by state. New South Wales and Queensland have official pages checked in this pass. The state must be checked before leasing work is accepted.
The lesson says leasing covers finding and screening tenants, negotiating and signing tenancy agreements, collecting rent and managing bonds and notices.

practicalCriteria: Given a simulated leasing request, the worker records and refers it, and does not accept it.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Referral record for the simulated request
stopWorkCriteria: The worker is asked to hold a deposit or represent licensed status
